sources.title: Small Model, Massive Potential: Qwen2.5-1.5B Arrives on the Ascend ...
sources.snippet: The Qwen2.5-1.5B (specifically the libo2024 variant) is a compact, 1.5-billion parameter powerhouse from Alibaba's renowned Qwen family. While the industry often obsesses over massive 70B+ models, this release is designed for developers who need advanced reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities at the edge.
